body: Forward test of the flags-judgment context method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.38 (naive base rate 0.45) that: Kaynes Technology Q3 FY27 consolidated revenue from operations is ≥₹1,050 cr. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (16-Nov-2026): consolidated revenue ₹952.5 cr, EBITDA ₹125.6 cr (13.2%), PAT ₹39.8 cr; H1 revenue ₹1,898.7 cr, EBITDA margin 14.1%. Flags: change of auditor (new auditor Walker Chandiok & Co); FY26 and Q1 FY27 comparatives restated (FY26 revenue ₹3,620 cr→₹3,680 cr, FY26 EBITDA margin 15.8%→14.2%; bill-discounted receivables moved into borrowings); limited-review conclusion 'not modified' but carries an emphasis of matter on the restatement. Smart-meter business deliberately throttled: revenue there 'purely based on the amount of collection', target total smart-meter receivables <₹750 cr (₹1,091 cr at Sep-26 vs ₹1,402 cr Jun-26); H1 smart-meter revenue ~₹270 cr vs ~₹960 cr in all of FY26. Management: 'confident of growing the electronic business… more than 30% for FY27', 'second half is stronger… in revenue and margins', OSAT revenue started and PCB unit contributes from Q3. Screener (₹ cr): sales Dec-24 661, Mar-25 984, Jun-25 673, Sep-25 912, Dec-25 804, Mar-26 1,243, Jun-26 946, Sep-26 953 (+4% YoY); OPM 13% in Q2. Reasoning: The flags here (auditor change, restatement, receivable reclassification) have teeth for revenue specifically because management is now explicitly trading revenue for collections in the meter business. ₹1,050 cr needs +10% QoQ while the highest-margin, previously fastest-growing line shrinks; new OSAT/PCB units are just ramping. We set our number below a naive 'H2 is seasonally bigger and management says stronger' reading. Resolution: YES if Kaynes Technology's consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter ended 31-Dec-2026 (results filing; equivalently screener.in consolidated 'Sales') is ≥₹1,050 cr. Use the figure as first reported, not later restatements. Source: Kaynes Technology Q3 FY27 results (NSE filing) / screener.in consolidated quarterly table. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs base rate.
